Ltd_Eng_Prof.label: Have Limited English Proficiency
Ltd_Eng_Prof.def: Percentage of people ages five and older who report that they speak English less than “very well”
Ltd_Eng_Prof.src: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

Born_Outside_US.label: Born Outside of the US
Born_Outside_US.def: Percentage of people born outside the U.S. or U.S. territories (U.S. territories include Puerto Rico, American Samoa, Guam, the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, and the U.S. Virgin Islands) or abroad to a U.S. citizen parent or parents
Born_Outside_US.src: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

School_Absent.label: Elementary School Absenteeism
School_Absent.def: Percentage of public school students, grades K to 5, who were chronically absent during the 2022-2023 school year. Chronically absent is defined as missing >10% of reported school days (absent+present)

On_Time_HS_Grad.label: On-Time High School Graduation
On_Time_HS_Grad.def: Percentage of public high school freshman from the 2019-2020 school year who graduated in 4 years
On_Time_HS_Grad.years: 2019-2020 cohort, graduation status as of August 2023
On_Time_HS_Grad.src: NYC Public Schools graduation data obtained from New York State Department of Education

Edu_Did_Not_Complete_HS.label: Highest Level of Education Achieved: did not finish high school
Edu_Did_Not_Complete_HS.def: Percentage of adults ages 25 and older whose highest level of education is less than a high school diploma or GED; Percentage of adults ages 25 and older who have a high school diploma or a high school diploma and some college; Percentage of adults ages 25 and older who obtained an educational degree above a High School diploma (Associate’s, Bachelor’s, or Graduate or professional degree)
Edu_Did_Not_Complete_HS.src: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

Edu_HSGrad_Some_College.label: Highest Level of Education Achieved: high school or some college
Edu_HSGrad_Some_College.def: Percentage of adults ages 25 and older whose highest level of education is less than a high school diploma or GED; Percentage of adults ages 25 and older who have a high school diploma or a high school diploma and some college; Percentage of adults ages 25 and older who obtained an educational degree above a High School diploma (Associate’s, Bachelor’s, or Graduate or professional degree)
Edu_HSGrad_Some_College.src: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

Edu_College_Degree_And_Higher.label: Highest Level of Education Achieved: college degree or higher
Edu_College_Degree_And_Higher.def: Percentage of adults ages 25 and older whose highest level of education is less than a high school diploma or GED; Percentage of adults ages 25 and older who have a high school diploma or a high school diploma and some college; Percentage of adults ages 25 and older who obtained an educational degree above a High School diploma (Associate’s, Bachelor’s, or Graduate or professional degree)
Edu_College_Degree_And_Higher.src: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

Poverty.label: Poverty
Poverty.def: Percentage of residents living below 100% of New York City’s calculated poverty threshold based on income and necessary expenses
Poverty.src: American Community Survey Public Use Micro Sample files as augmented by NYC Opportunity

Unemployment.label: Unemployment
Unemployment.def: Percentage of the civilian (non-military) labor force (ages 16 and older) who are unemployed
Unemployment.src: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

Rent_Burden.label: Rent Burden
Rent_Burden.def: Percentage of renter-occupied homes whose gross rent (contract rent plus estimated average monthly cost of utilities including electricity, gas, and water and sewer) is equal to or greater than 30 percent of household income in past 12 months
Rent_Burden.src: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

Avertable_Death.label: Avertable Deaths
Avertable_Death.def: This measure considers income as a factor in death rates. Avertable deaths are defined as the expected percentage of deaths that could have been averted had each neighborhood had the same mortality rates as the top 5 highest average household income "baseline" neighborhoods.
Avertable_Death.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics and U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

Helpful_Neighbor.label: Helpful Neighbors
Helpful_Neighbor.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report they strongly agree or somewhat agree that people around their neighborhood are willing to help their neighbors.

Assault_Hosp.label: Non-Fatal Assault Hospitalizations
Assault_Hosp.def: Rate of assault hospitalizations per 100,000 people
Assault_Hosp.src: New York State Department of Health, Statewide Planning and Research Cooperative System (SPARCS)

Jail_Incarceration.label: Jail Incarceration
Jail_Incarceration.def: Rate of residents admitted to local jails (not including prisons) per 100,000 adults ages 16 and older

Homes_AC.label: Air Conditioning
Homes_AC.def: Percentage of households that reported having functioning air conditioning

Air_Pollution.label: Air Pollution
Air_Pollution.def: Annual average micrograms of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) per cubic meter of air (mcg/m3)

Homes_Any_Defects.label: Renter-occupied homes with any health-related housing problems
Homes_Any_Defects.def: Percentage of renter-occupied homes that reported any health-related maintenance problems (water leaks, cracks and holes, inadequate heating, presence of mice or rats, toilet breakdowns, or peeling paint)

Homes_Roach.label: Homes Reporting Cockroaches
Homes_Roach.def: Percentage of households that reported seeing at least one cockroach daily over the last month

Ratio_Bodega_Supermarket.label: Ratio Of Bodegas To Supermarkets
Ratio_Bodega_Supermarket.def: The number of bodegas per supermarket within a CD based on address of business
Ratio_Bodega_Supermarket.src: New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets

Farmers_Markets.label: Farmers Markets
Farmers_Markets.def: The number of farmers markets within a CD based on location or address of market.
Farmers_Markets.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Chronic Disease Prevention

Bike_Coverage.label: Bicycle Network Coverage
Bike_Coverage.def: Percentage of streets with bicycle lanes (conventional and protected bicycle lanes, excluding sharrows, dirt trails, boardwalks, and velodrome tracks)
Bike_Coverage.src: NYC Department of Transportation, Safer Cycling: Bicycle Ridership and Safety in New York City

Pedestrian_Hosp.label: Pedestrian Injury Hospitalizations
Pedestrian_Hosp.def: Rate of pedestrian injury hospitalizations per 100,000 people
Pedestrian_Hosp.src: New York State Department of Health, Statewide Planning and Research Cooperative System (SPARCS)

Late_No_Prenatal.label: Late Or No Prenatal Care
Late_No_Prenatal.def: Percentage of live births receiving late prenatal care (after the first and second trimesters) or no prenatal care
Late_No_Prenatal.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics

Preterm_Births.label: Preterm Births
Preterm_Births.def: Percentage of live births that are born preterm (three or more weeks before the due date)
Preterm_Births.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics

Teen_Births.label: Teen Births
Teen_Births.def: Rate of births in which the mother was under 20 years old per 1,000 females ages 15 to 19
Teen_Births.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics

Child_Obesity.label: Childhood Obesity
Child_Obesity.def: Percentage of public school children in grades K to 8 who have obesity (age- and sex-specific body mass index greater than or equal to the 95th percentile, based on CDC's 2022 growth charts)

Child_Asthma.label: Child Asthma Emergency Department Visits
Child_Asthma.def: Rate of emergency department visits for asthma among children per 10,000 children ages 5 to 17
Child_Asthma.src: New York State Department of Health, Statewide Planning and Research Cooperative System (SPARCS)

Self_Rep_Health.label: Self-Reported Health
Self_Rep_Health.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report their overall health is “excellent,” "very good" or “good” on a scale of excellent, very good, good, fair or poor

Physical_Activity.label: Physical Activity
Physical_Activity.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report participating in any physical activity in the last 30 days

Sugary_Drink.label: Sugary Drink Consumption
Sugary_Drink.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report drinking one or more 12 ounce sugar-sweetened beverage (sodas, fruit punch, sweet iced tea, sports drinks, etc.) on average per day

Fruit_Veg.label: Fruit and Vegetable Consumption
Fruit_Veg.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report eating one or more servings of fruits and/or vegetables in the last day

Smoking.label: Current Smokers
Smoking.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report being current smokers (smoking at least 100 cigarettes and now report smoking every day or some days)

Uninsured.label: Health Insurance
Uninsured.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report not having health insurance coverage

Unmet_Med_Care.label: Unmet Medical Care
Unmet_Med_Care.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report not getting needed medical care at least once in the past 12 months

Avoidable_Adult_Hosp.label: Avoidable Hospitalizations Among Adults
Avoidable_Adult_Hosp.def: Rate of avoidable adult hospitalizations per 100,000 adults ages 18 and older
Avoidable_Adult_Hosp.src: New York State Department of Health, Statewide Planning and Research Cooperative System (SPARCS)

Falls_Hosp.label: Fall-Related Hospitalizations Among Older Adults
Falls_Hosp.def: Rate of fall-related hospitalizations per 100,000 adults ages 65 and older
Falls_Hosp.src: New York State Department of Health, Statewide Planning and Research Cooperative System (SPARCS)

Flu_Vaccination.label: Flu Vaccination
Flu_Vaccination.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report receiving a flu vaccination in the last 12 months

HPV_Vaccination_All.label: HPV Vaccination
HPV_Vaccination_All.def: Percentage of adolescents who completed the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination series by their 13th birthday

Obesity.label: Obesity
Obesity.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who have obesity (Body Mass Index of 30 or greater) based on self-reported height and weight

Diabetes.label: Diabetes
Diabetes.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report ever being told by a healthcare professional that they have diabetes

Hypertension.label: Hypertension
Hypertension.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report ever being told by a healthcare professional that they have hypertension, also known as high blood pressure

HIV_Diagnoses.label: New HIV Diagnoses
HIV_Diagnoses.def: Rate of new HIV diagnoses per 100,000 people

HepC_Reports.label: New Hepatitis C Reports
HepC_Reports.def: Rate of new chronic hepatitis C reports per 100,000 people
HepC_Reports.src: NYC DOHMH, Communicable Disease Surveillance Registry

Binge_Drink.label: Binge Drinking
Binge_Drink.def: Percentage of adults ages 18 and older who report binge drinking (5 or more drinks for men and 4 or more drinks for women on one occasion during the past 30 days)

Psych_Hosp.label: Psychiatric Hospitalizations
Psych_Hosp.def: Rate of psychiatric hospitalizations per 100,000 adults ages 18 and older
Psych_Hosp.src: New York State Department of Health, Statewide Planning and Research Cooperative System (SPARCS)

Infant_Mort.label: Infant Mortality
Infant_Mort.def: Rate of infant deaths (under one year old) per 1,000 live births
Infant_Mort.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics

Premature_Mort_Number.label: Premature Mortality (deaths)
Premature_Mort_Number.def: Number of premature deaths (before the age of 65)
Premature_Mort_Number.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics

Premature_Mort_Rate.label: Premature Mortality (rate)
Premature_Mort_Rate.def: Rate of premature deaths (before the age of 65) per 100,000 people
Premature_Mort_Rate.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics

Life_Expectancy.label: Life Expectancy
Life_Expectancy.src: NYC DOHMH, Bureau of Vital Statistics

chp_source: NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, 2026 Community Health Profiles public use dataset
dsny_source: DSNY Monthly Tonnage Data, NYC Open Data (ebb7-mvp5)
